text: Affection is at zero, but I will not chase it; the clay bank is still the thing worth my attention.
Started cut (The clay bank): A piece of clay is a thing worth keeping, and I keep things.
Nobody is here to be bothered by, so I will go back to the clay and keep something, which at least goes better than sulking.
